bilder.name: textur-land
bilder.prompt:
A full sheet of loose, transparent watercolour washes for the land of a map: sand, pale ochre and pale olive, soft blooms, a few darker soft patches like hills, granulation of the paint visible. No shapes of anything, no objects, no lines, no lettering, the washes cover the whole sheet evenly to the edges. Very reduced, loose watercolour sketch on warm white paper, like a quick painted study: few thin broken ink lines, flat transparent pale washes that bleed softly, lots of untouched paper, no shading detail, no texture, no lettering. Small muted palette: sand, ochre, terracotta, blue-grey, olive, soft ink grey.

The attached image shows the painting style only (ignore its content).
